text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Monday received a message from Libyan leader colonel Muammar Gaddafi handed by visiting Libyan Prime Minister Abdul Majid al-Gu'ud.
- Tunisian businessmen to visit Tripoli by the end of May.
- President Ben Ali on Monday received a report from Prime Minister Hamed Karoui on results of forum on exports policy held last week.
- Exports rose 14.2 percent during the first four months of 1997 compared with the same period of 1996.
- Consumer price index rose 0.1 percent in April compared to March.
- The 19th Arab lawyers congress to be held in the Tunisian resort of Sousse on May 27-31.
- Tunisian Banque internationale Arabe de Tunisie plans to use global depositary receipts (GDR's) to raise capital.
- Tunisia and Libya aim to rise trade exchanges to 350 million dollars.
- President Ben Ali on Monday asked Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to open the 26th session of Maghreb medical congress to be held in Tunis on May 19-21.
